qs.s: The school breaks up on Friday afternoon, and lessons will start again in January. Parents are asked to collect their children at noon. What does “breaks up” mean here?
o: kết thúc học kỳ để nghỉ
qs.a: kết thúc học kỳ để nghỉ
qs.say: The school breaks up on Friday afternoon, and lessons will start again in January. Parents are asked to collect their children at noon.
qs.vi: Trường nghỉ vào chiều thứ Sáu và bài học sẽ bắt đầu lại vào tháng Giêng. Phụ huynh được đề nghị đón con lúc trưa.
qs.why: (school) break up = kết thúc học kỳ để nghỉ; break up (with sb) = chia tay.

qs.s: Children will go back to school on Monday after the long break. Parents have been busy buying books and uniforms all week. What does “go back to school” mean?
qs.say: Children will go back to school on Monday after the long break. Parents have been busy buying books and uniforms all week.
qs.vi: Trẻ em sẽ quay lại trường vào thứ Hai sau kỳ nghỉ dài. Phụ huynh bận mua sách và đồng phục cả tuần.
qs.why: go back (to school) = quay lại trường/đi học lại sau kỳ nghỉ.

sections.title: Nói vận dụng
sections.note: Bấm ghi âm và trả lời bằng tiếng Anh, cố dùng các từ gợi ý; trang sẽ chấm ước tính 4 tiêu chí.

qs.s: Tell me about the way you spent your free time when you were in your teens. Did you ever go on a date, and who did you spend most of your time with?
qs.vi: Hãy kể về cách bạn dành thời gian rảnh khi ở tuổi thiếu niên. Bạn đã bao giờ đi hẹn hò chưa, và bạn dành phần lớn thời gian với ai?
qs.why: Kể về hoạt động bạn tham gia (engage in), một buổi hẹn (date) hoặc người bạn dẫn đi đâu (take someone to), rồi nêu cảm xúc khi dần quen nhau (get to know) hoặc đang yêu (in love).
qs.sample: When I was in my teens, I used to engage in a lot of school clubs, especially drama and basketball. I did not go on many dates, but I once went on a date with a classmate. I decided to take someone to a small ice-cream shop near our school, because it was cheap and quiet. We talked for hours, and that is how we got to know each other. I was never really in love at that age, yet those afternoons taught me how to be polite and how to listen carefully.

qs.s: Describe a wedding you have attended or would like to have. What happened at the ceremony, and what did people do afterwards?
qs.vi: Hãy mô tả một đám cưới bạn đã dự hoặc muốn có. Điều gì diễn ra ở buổi lễ và mọi người làm gì sau đó?
qs.why: Kể thứ tự: đính hôn, buổi lễ, tiệc, tuần trăng mật, rồi nói về ngày kỷ niệm hoặc kế hoạch có con.
qs.sample: My cousin got engaged to his girlfriend after a couple of years together. The wedding ceremony took place in a garden, and about eighty guests watched them exchange rings. Afterwards, we all went to a reception in a nearby restaurant, where the families shared a big meal. It was a lovely celebration, full of music and speeches. The couple went on honeymoon in Japan for ten days. Last month they celebrated their first anniversary, and they told us they hope to get pregnant next year. I would like a smaller wedding, but the same warm atmosphere.

qs.s: Have you ever known a couple whose relationship started well but then began to go wrong? Explain what happened and how they felt.
qs.vi: Bạn có biết cặp đôi nào mà mối quan hệ khởi đầu tốt nhưng sau đó trục trặc không? Hãy giải thích chuyện gì đã xảy ra và cảm xúc của họ.
qs.why: Mở đầu: họ hạnh phúc ra sao; sau đó điều gì go wrong; kết quả (get divorced, the following year) và bài học.
qs.sample: My neighbours looked very happy when they moved in, but things started to go wrong after a few years. He worked long hours, and she felt she had to raise the children on her own. They argued about money as well, and every conversation became a struggle. They tried counselling, but eventually they decided to get divorced. The following year she moved to a smaller flat near her parents. Now both of them seem calmer. I think the main lesson is that couples must communicate honestly before small problems grow bigger.

qs.s: Why do some cities attract more tourists than others? What can a place or a business do to appeal to visitors?
qs.vi: Vì sao một số thành phố thu hút du khách hơn những nơi khác? Một địa điểm hay doanh nghiệp có thể làm gì để hấp dẫn khách?
qs.why: Nêu 2–3 yếu tố: cảnh đẹp (visual appeal), giá rẻ (price appeal), lễ hội (draw), rồi nói về việc doanh nghiệp có survive hay không.
qs.sample: In my opinion, cities attract tourists mainly through culture, safety and good prices. A famous festival can draw thousands of visitors, while a clean old town has real visual appeal. Cheap flights and hotels give a destination strong price appeal, which is important for students. Local shops also need to appeal to travellers by selling unique souvenirs. If a small business cannot do that, it may find it hard to survive when bigger shops open nearby. For example, my hometown has beautiful lakes, yet it lacks good advertising, so fewer people visit than I would expect.

qs.s: Do small shops and small businesses in your area have a hard time? How do ordinary people make money when the economy is weak?
qs.vi: Các cửa hàng và doanh nghiệp nhỏ ở khu bạn có gặp khó khăn không? Người bình thường kiếm tiền thế nào khi kinh tế yếu?
qs.why: Nêu cuộc cạnh tranh với siêu thị (struggle), người dân kiếm sống khó (struggle to make a living) và thói quen tiêu dùng (consumption, consume).
qs.sample: Yes, I think small shops are in a constant struggle with big supermarkets. Many owners struggle to survive because customers prefer lower prices. Some families struggle to make a living when the economy slows down, so they reduce their spending. For example, people consume less meat and buy fewer luxury products. Energy consumption also falls because households switch off lights more often. Even offices try to save money on consumable items such as paper and ink. Personally, I try to support local shops, although I admit the supermarket is sometimes more convenient and cheaper.

qs.s: If you had some spare money, would you place it in a bank or invest it? What risks and rewards should people think about?
qs.vi: Nếu có một khoản tiền dư, bạn sẽ gửi ngân hàng hay đầu tư? Mọi người nên cân nhắc những rủi ro và lợi ích nào?
qs.why: So sánh gửi tiết kiệm an toàn với đầu tư rủi ro hơn; nhắc điều kiện hợp đồng và phạt; kết luận lựa chọn của bạn.
qs.sample: I would probably place money in a savings account first, because it is safe. Some banks guarantee savings up to a certain limit, which gives people peace of mind. If I agree not to withdraw the money for a year, the bank may offer a better rate, and I may have to pay a small fine if I break the agreement. Of course, other options can pay higher returns, so I might invest money in shares later. However, I would never invest everything at once, because risk is always part of the game.

qs.s: Tell me about a healthy food you like or dislike. Do you know anyone who has had a serious illness because of their lifestyle?
qs.vi: Hãy kể về một món ăn tốt cho sức khỏe mà bạn thích hoặc không thích. Bạn có biết ai mắc bệnh nặng vì lối sống của họ không?
qs.why: Giới thiệu món (barley, be rich in), nói bạn ăn thường xuyên không (consume), rồi kể về người từng được chẩn đoán bệnh.
qs.sample: My favourite healthy dish is barley soup, which my grandmother cooks in winter. Barley is rich in fibre and vitamins, so it keeps you full for hours. I try to consume more vegetables and less sugar these days. Last year my uncle was diagnosed with diabetes, mainly because he ate too many sweets and rarely exercised. Since then, the whole family has changed its habits. We go for a walk after dinner and we cook at home more often. I think prevention is easier than treatment, and diet is a good place to begin.

qs.s: Describe a long journey you made recently. How did you travel, and what was the best or worst part?
qs.vi: Hãy mô tả một chuyến đi dài bạn thực hiện gần đây. Bạn đi bằng gì và phần tốt nhất hay tệ nhất là gì?
words: my only real complaint is that
qs.why: Kể chuyến đi theo thứ tự: phương tiện, vé, thời gian chờ, rồi phàn nàn duy nhất.
qs.sample: Last month I made a long journey to visit my aunt. I took a flight from Hanoi, then continued by train. A return ticket was cheaper than two single tickets, so I bought one. At the station, I had to wait half an hour for the next train, and I stood on platform two. Trains run every ten minutes in the city, but the service is slower in the countryside. My only real complaint is that the waiting room had no heating. I also had to wait for 20 minutes to buy a coffee. Still, the scenery was beautiful. If I travelled daily, I would buy a season ticket.

qs.s: How is public transport where you live? Talk about traffic, roads and what people do when they have to queue or wait.
qs.vi: Giao thông công cộng ở nơi bạn sống thế nào? Hãy nói về giao thông, đường sá và việc mọi người làm gì khi phải xếp hàng hoặc chờ.
qs.why: Mô tả trạm xe gần nhà (round the corner), tình trạng kẹt xe ở ngã tư (junction), giá vé go up, và cách bạn tránh tắc đường.
qs.sample: There is a bus stop just round the corner from my house, which is very convenient. In the morning, people wait in a queue for the bus, and the traffic at the main junction is terrible. When I drive, I sometimes take a side road to avoid the jam, but the motorway is faster at weekends. Public transport prices go up every year, so many people complain. Christmas is just round the corner, so the streets will be even busier soon. In the future, I hope the city builds a metro line to reduce congestion.

qs.s: Talk about your school days. How was the school year organised, and what did you do during breaks and holidays?
qs.vi: Hãy nói về thời đi học của bạn. Năm học được tổ chức thế nào, và bạn làm gì trong giờ giải lao và kỳ nghỉ?
qs.why: Mô tả năm học (be divided into, term), môn học (maths), giờ nghỉ, rồi nói về kỳ nghỉ (break up) và việc go back hoặc học tiếp (further education).
qs.sample: In my country, the school year is divided into two terms. I was good at maths, but I preferred literature. We had a short break in the morning, and a one-hour lunch break when we ate with our friends. When the school breaks up in summer, I usually travelled to my grandparents' house. After the holidays, we had to go back to school in September, and it always felt strange to wake up early again. After finishing secondary school, I considered further education at a college, because I wanted practical skills.
